text:
You need a simple Athens version of the reference site built in 48 hours, with the same overall content and design translated to your location.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I can build this quickly and cleanly. I have 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS, so I’m comfortable handling both the implementation and the details that make a simple marketing site look polished.

For a project like this, I’d focus on recreating the structure and visual style of the example while swapping in Athens-specific content and making sure the final site is responsive and consistent across screen sizes. Since the scope is straightforward and the design is already defined, I can move fast and keep the build efficient.

A relevant project I’ve done was a monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group in real estate. I built a queue that renders owner statements to PDF overnight and stores them in S3 instead of generating them on request. That system handled 12k statements a month, and request timeouts went from daily to none. While that project was backend-heavy, it reflects how I approach work: build the right thing, keep it reliable, and make sure it performs well under real use.

If you want, I can take this on and deliver within your 48-hour window. I’d work from the provided reference, match the structure and style as closely as possible, and make sure the Athens version is ready to publish without unnecessary back-and-forth. If there are any specific text swaps, images, or contact details you want changed for Athens, I can incorporate those as part of the build.

If you’d like, I can start immediately.
